clue.text: Obvious means to keep the traffic flowing?

definitions.text: Obvious means to keep the traffic flowing?

parts.words: Obvious means to keep the traffic flowing?
parts.note: read literally, an evident route kept open is the way vehicles keep moving; it is also the name of a road where stopping is banned

explanation.definitionFit: A road on which vehicles may not stop is designed so that the flow of vehicles is never blocked.

clue.text: Heather and I tucked in before getting underwear

parts.note: ling is a common heather

indicators.note: tucked in means the letter I is slipped inside the word for before

parts.note: ere is an old word for before

explanation.surface: Heather and I put a garment away before dressing.
explanation.definitionFit: Women's intimate garments are underclothes, so a synonym for underwear.

clue.text: Thanks for understanding

explanation.definitionFit: Gratitude expressed is a form of thanks; full comprehension of a matter is a grasp or understanding of it.

clue.text: Conclude that a storm is brewing

explanation.definitionFit: To finish something off is to bring it to an end; when a gale is building, the breeze is literally rising.

clue.text: Truly right for quite some time

parts.note: yea is an old word for truly or indeed

explanation.surface: Honestly, correct for a lengthy spell.
explanation.definitionFit: Twelve months is a considerable period, quite a stretch of time.

clue.text: Commenced attack

explanation.definitionFit: To begin a task is to start it; to assault someone is to fall on them.

clue.text: Monk takes a Frenchman into Californian city

indicators.note: into means the article and the Frenchman are placed inside the city

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles
M is short for Monsieur, a Frenchman

explanation.surface: A monk brings a man from France to Los Angeles.
explanation.definitionFit: A Buddhist priest or teacher in Tibet is a kind of monk.

clue.text: Clear winner is late collecting diploma

parts.note: the late person is dead
a cert is a certificate, such as a diploma

explanation.surface: An obvious victor was tardy in picking up a qualification.
explanation.walkthrough: 'collecting' only joins the pieces, which sit side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse or competitor sure to win is an absolute certainty in betting slang.

clue.text: Avon art gallery displaying sloth, say

parts.note: Anthony Eden, the British Prime Minister, became the Earl of Avon
the Tate is the famous London art gallery

explanation.surface: A gallery in Avon shows a painting of laziness, or of the animal.
explanation.walkthrough: Avon looks like the English county or river; it is the title of Anthony Eden (British Prime Minister in the 1950s), Earl of Avon. 'say' marks sloth as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Sloths belong to the order of toothless mammals, so a sloth is one example of this group.

clue.text: Crack shot

explanation.definitionFit: To break with a sharp crack is to give way suddenly; a quick photograph taken casually is a shot of this kind.

clue.text: She was created by a jockey of gaunt features

parts.note: a jockey is a horse rider
gaunt, drawn features are haggard

explanation.surface: A woman was made by a hollow-cheeked jockey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'She' is the title of a Victorian adventure novel, so the definition names its author rather than a woman's creator.
explanation.definitionFit: The Victorian novelist Henry Rider Haggard wrote the adventure story titled She.

clue.text: Take umbrage when told to fetch the stylus

explanation.definitionFit: Becoming annoyed or resentful is taking offence; taken literally the phrase is to collect a gramophone's pin.

clue.text: Crazy because of drugs

parts.note: crack is a form of cocaine
pot is slang for cannabis

explanation.surface: Someone has gone mad through taking narcotics.
explanation.walkthrough: One word 'drugs' gives two pieces, two different narcotics.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as an adjective, the word describes a wild, unhinged scheme or person, so it is a synonym for mad.

clue.text: Monitor movements of American banker in Europe

parts.note: an offender is tagged electronically so the authorities can track him
US means American

explanation.surface: Someone keeps track of a US banker working in Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'banker' is the crossword sense of a river, something with banks; this one flows through Spain and Portugal.
explanation.definitionFit: The longest river of the Iberian peninsula reaches the Atlantic at Lisbon, and a river has banks.

clue.text: Not in time to find goods lost in transport

parts.note: someone not in is out
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: Someone is away when they come to look for freight that went missing.
explanation.walkthrough: Besides a power cut, the word also means a quantity of goods lost or missing in transit or storage.
explanation.definitionFit: In commerce the word names the amount of a shipment that goes missing in transit.

clue.text: In another age she was worshipped

indicators.note: In tells us the letters sit inside the run of words another age

explanation.surface: In a past era a certain woman was venerated.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run from the end of 'another' into 'age'.
explanation.definitionFit: The queen of the Greek gods, wife of Zeus, was a goddess venerated by the ancient Greeks.

clue.text: Present and former US president in this city

parts.note: present in the sense of here, not away
Gerald Ford was US president in the 1970s

explanation.surface: The current and an earlier American leader are both in this place.
explanation.definitionFit: A cathedral town in the west of England, it is a city.

clue.text: Could be one way to aerate the garden

definitions.text: Could be one way to aerate the garden

parts.words: Could be one way to aerate the garden
parts.note: turning over the soil with a spade loosens it, which is the instruction a gardener might give; the answer is also a finger or numeral

explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it is a command to break up the soil, letting air into the ground.

clue.text: They treat godly believers holding Christian books

indicators.note: holding means one word contains the books inside it

parts.note: deists believe in a god
NT is the New Testament

explanation.surface: Religious believers carrying gospels look after people.
explanation.definitionFit: Dental practitioners give treatment to patients' teeth.

clue.text: Early contest generates excitement

explanation.definitionFit: A preliminary round of a race decides who goes through to the final; strong passion or agitation is also called warmth of this kind.

clue.text: A personal account causing repugnance

parts.note: one's own version of events is a personal account

explanation.surface: Someone's story of events provokes disgust.
explanation.definitionFit: Strong dislike or disgust is a synonym for repugnance.

clue.text: Ignore devastated district

indicators.note: devastated means wrecked, so the letters of the clue word are broken up and rebuilt

explanation.surface: Pay no attention to an area laid waste.
explanation.definitionFit: An area or zone of a country is a synonym for a district.

clue.text: Being given a transfer helped

explanation.definitionFit: An employee lent temporarily to another post has been transferred; supporting a motion formally means backing it, so supported.

clue.text: Is refused leave to bring container over 20 cwt

parts.note: a can is a container

indicators.note: over in a down clue means the word for 20 hundredweight is turned upward

parts.note: twenty hundredweight make a ton

explanation.surface: Someone is not allowed to carry a box weighing more than a ton.
explanation.definitionFit: Being forbidden to do something means one is not able to, so the modal verb fits.

clue.text: Undisguised anger smouldering in church

parts.note: undisguised feelings are frank, open
to incense is to make angry, so anger as a verb

explanation.surface: Open fury flares up during a service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'smouldering' seems part of the anger; it is the definition, the aromatic resin burnt during worship.
explanation.definitionFit: This aromatic gum resin is burnt as incense, giving off fragrant smoke during religious services.

clue.text: Wide range of high-quality records

parts.note: A, as in A1 or grade A, means top quality
LPs are long-playing records

explanation.surface: A broad selection of excellent discs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'high' tempts as mountains; the definition is 'Wide range', the European mountain chain.
explanation.definitionFit: The great mountain chain of central Europe is a broad range of peaks.

clue.text: Criticise motor parking

parts.note: a motor is a car
P is the sign for parking

explanation.surface: Find fault with a car's parking.
explanation.definitionFit: To find fault in a petty, nagging way is to complain.

clue.text: A party at home is murder

parts.note: a do is a party or celebration
someone at home is in

explanation.surface: A gathering held in the house turns out to be a killing.
explanation.definitionFit: The informal phrasal verb means to kill someone.

clue.text: Watch salesman meets consumer

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative
an eater consumes food

explanation.surface: A trader comes face to face with a customer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Watch' looks like a verb; it is a noun, a timepiece that chimes the time when a button is pressed.
explanation.definitionFit: A striking timepiece that sounds the hours on demand is called by this name.

clue.text: Models talk glibly to Poles

parts.note: to patter is to talk rapidly and smoothly
N and S are the north and south poles

explanation.surface: Fashion models chat smoothly to people from Poland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poles' suggests people from Poland; it is the two magnetic poles, north and south.
explanation.definitionFit: Designs or templates to be copied are examples that serve as models.
